name: Panorama Restaurant
kurzbeschreibung:
**Panorama Restaurant in Schwangau**

Discover breathtaking views of **Neuschwanstein** and **Hohenschwangau** castles from the **Panorama Restaurant** in **Schwangau**. Enjoy traditional Tyrolean cuisine with a view, including hearty dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Schweinsbraten**, and **Käsespätzle**. Whether you're craving a cozy lunch or a fine dinner, this restaurant offers a perfect blend of regional flavors and stunning Alpine scenery. Don’t miss the chance to savor authentic **Tirol** hospitality with a side of postcard-worthy vistas!
